desc: Compute the length (number of digits) for every integer from $1$ to $N$ and store them in an array.
Group the integers by their lengths and calculate the count of numbers for each length $L$ (from $1$ to $\approx 6$).
Derive the mathematical formula involving polynomial coefficients $A_j$.
Implement NTT-based polynomial multiplication to compute $A_j$.
Compute the final answer by summing contributions based on $A_j$, factorials, and powers of 10.
